html:
{%- if doc.status not in ("Released", "Sold") -%}

{{ _("This document can be printed only after the vehicle is released.") }}

{%- else -%} {%- set loan = frappe.get_doc("Loan", doc.current_loan) -%} {%- set company = frappe.get_doc("Company", doc.hypothecated_to or loan.company) -%}

{{ _("Date") }}: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.noc_issued_on or frappe.utils.nowdate()) }}

{{ _("To") }},
{{ _("The Registering Authority") }}

{{ _("Subject: Termination of hypothecation on vehicle {0}").format(doc.registration_number or doc.chassis_number) }}

{{ _("Dear Sir or Madam,") }}

{{ _("The vehicle below was hypothecated to {0} under loan account {1}. The loan is now closed. Please cancel the hypothecation endorsement on the Certificate of Registration.").format(company.company_name, loan.name) }}

{{ _("Registration Number") }}{{ doc.registration_number or "" }}
{{ _("Chassis Number") }}{{ doc.chassis_number or "" }}
{{ _("Engine Number") }}{{ doc.engine_number or "" }}
{{ _("Make and Model") }}{{ doc.vehicle_model }}
{{ _("Registered Owner") }}{{ doc.rc_owner_name or doc.applicant_name }}

{{ _("Form 35, duly signed, is enclosed.") }}

{{ _("For") }} {{ company.company_name }}

{{ _("Authorised Signatory") }}

{%- endif -%}
name: Vehicle RTO Letter
